segments.text: Ok so, this is the frontend tools page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Google ADK, and I have implemented this page in my project.
So this is my project, umm, and this is the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked it to show only sev one incidents, and the agent just answered in text. The filter stayed on all.
So the page says the agent can call the tool, and the frontend runs it.
But the page only shows the Vue side. With a normal ADK agent the tool never reaches the model, because the agent needs the AGUI toolset, and, uh, this page never says that. With it added, it works.
